---
title: "Methods Labs"
---

The Fall 2026 labs are being redesigned around the Univision survey-production workflow. Existing R materials remain available in the repository while the revised labs are prepared.

## Planned labs

1. Reproducible survey workflow
2. Weighted estimates and uncertainty
3. Subgroup analysis and visualization
4. From survey data to professional report

Each lab will include a source file, rendered instructions, data documentation, and a reproducible submission template.
